    Drip Tapes and Drip Lines: Tailored to Agricultural Needs

    Our extensive range of drip irrigation solutions encompasses both drip tapes and drip lines, each designed to address specific agricultural requirements.

    ​

    Here's what you need to know:

    1. Drip Tape: Integrated Emitters

    • Drip tapes are equipped with integrated emitters, which are small outlets that release water directly to the root zones of plants. These integrated emitters are spaced at regular intervals along the tape.

    • Drip tapes are ideal for row crops, vegetable cultivation, and orchards, offering precise and localized irrigation.

     

    2. Drip Line: Molded Emitters

    • Drip lines, on the other hand, feature molded emitters that are strategically placed along the line. These emitters are designed to provide uniform and controlled water distribution.

    • Drip lines are suitable for a wide range of applications, including landscape irrigation, greenhouses, and large-scale farming.
